preprocessing.duplicatePolicy: Same-label rows for an animal-minute collapse to one row with mean motion index; all rows for conflicting-label minutes are excluded.

interpretation: All reported scores are development-fold descriptive metrics over animals from the Perea source; they are not external validation.
Synthetic replicates are not independent animals. Macro summaries weight each held-out animal equally.
Annotated label-run lengths may be biased by the source's carry-forward rule and are not unbiased biological bout durations.
No score enables a behavior model or changes FarmEngine defaults.
